Description: In the second quarter of 2024, the net income of e-commerce in Malaysia reached more than 302 billion Malaysian ringgit, an increase from around 293 billion Malaysian ringgit in the previous quarter. The quarterly net income of e-commerce in the
country has been steadily increasing over the past few years. Read more
Note(s): Malaysia; Q1 2020 to Q2 2024; *Preliminary. 1 Malaysian ringgit is equal to 0.22 U.S. dollars and 0.21 euros as of August 2024. Read more
Source(s): Statistics Malaysia

Description: According to a survey on e-commerce consumer behavior in Malaysia in 2024, 46 percent of respondents stated that they had purchased something on an e-commerce platform in the past six months. By comparison, the same survey last year showed
that 39 percent of respondents had bought items online. Read more
Note(s): Malaysia; 2021 to 2024; 1,030 respondents; 18-74 years; nationally representative sample
Source(s): Ipsos

payments.text:
Description: The average transaction value per user of digital commerce in the digital payments market in Malaysia was modeled to be 3,230 U.S. dollars in 2024. From 2018 to 2024, the value rose by 1,850 U.S. dollars, though the increase followed an uneven
trajectory rather than a consistent upward trend. Between 2024 and 2030, the value will rise by 1,330 U.S. dollars, showing an overall upward trend with periodic ups and downs. Read more
Note(s): 2018 to 2030
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights

forecast_revenue.text:
Description: The number of users in the e-commerce market in Malaysia was modeled to be 10.67 million users in 2024. Following a continuous upward trend, the number of users has risen by 6.45 million users since 2017. Between 2024 and 2029, the number of
users will rise by 8.14 million users, continuing its consistent upward trajectory. Read more
Note(s): Malaysia; 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights
